sources.name: GitHub issues of recharts/recharts
sources.version: GitHub REST API 2022-11-28, state as of 2026-11-11
sources.license: GitHub Terms of Service (user content; only facts and our own summaries are kept)

provenance.notes: URL, number, title, state, dates, counts and labels are copied from the API response of each issue. Category, components, summary, resolution and lesson are written by the researcher (tools/extract/field-reports/curation) after reading the issue body returned by the search API and, for the issues listed in docs/research/field-reports.md, the full thread. daysOpen of an open issue is measured to the retrieval date. fixedBy is filled mechanically from merged pull requests that name the issue after a closing keyword. Reports marked needs-review state a cause that the researcher inferred from the symptom without a confirming statement in the issue.

reports.title: Fix direction: rtl problem
reports.summary: With direction: rtl on the page, chart numbers and texts were unreadable and the tooltip opened in the wrong place. Reported in 2016 and closed three years later.
reports.lesson: Charts are isolated from inherited direction: the SVG root sets its own direction and text anchoring explicitly, and tooltip coordinates are physical.

reports.title: Stacked bar chart RTL support
reports.summary: A team supporting Arabic countries used a CSS-flipping plugin around a stacked bar chart and found that the tooltip, the y-axis label and the order of bars were not mirrored — a chart drawn from computed coordinates is not affected by flipped CSS. Closed after two and a half years.
reports.lesson: Chart mirroring is a data-level option (reverse the category scale, move the value axis to inline-start side, anchor labels), implemented in the layout computation, with direction as an input.

reports.title: Problem with accessibilityLayer in RTL
reports.summary: In RTL the chart's keyboard layer moves to the previous point on ArrowLeft and the next on ArrowRight, as in LTR. Open for almost three years.
reports.lesson: Keyboard traversal of data points follows the visual order of the axis: if the scale is reversed for RTL, the arrow mapping reverses with it.

reports.title: Add locale support for number formatting (Arabic/Persian numerals) in charts
reports.summary: Axis ticks, tooltips and labels always used Western digits, which is inconsistent in Arabic and Persian interfaces whose other numbers use local digits.
reports.lesson: Charts take the locale's number formatter (including the numbering system) for every number they print, by default.
